description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android Activity named ContentInfoActivity that displays content details, fetches additional info from a remote API, and handles video playback using ExoPlayer. It manages UI components, network requests, and media playback lifecycle.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays content details, fetches info from an API, and manages video playback with ExoPlayer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, loads poster image, and fetches content info based on intent extras.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches content details from remote API and updates UI with title and description.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Handles 'Watch now' button click, requests playback URL from API, and initiates video playback.

methods.name: startPlayback
methods.description: Sets up ExoPlayer with the media URL and starts playback, managing UI visibility and error handling.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Pauses video playback when activity stops.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases ExoPlayer resources when activity is destroyed.
